items.raw_excerpt: Paraguay's Foreign Minister Ruben Ramirez, left, poses for a photo with Japan's Crown Prince Akishino and Crown Princess Kiko upon their arrival at Silvio Pettirossi International Airport in Luque, Paraguay, on Wednesday. items.raw_excerpt: Where can convenient store chain Oxxo expand now that it has locations on virtually every corner in Mexico? The answer is shockingly simple.
